quote: Though leaves are many, the root is one; / Through all the lying days of my youth / I swayed my leaves and flowers in the sun; / Now I may wither into the truth.
source: W. B. Yeats, The Coming of Wisdom with Time, the whole poem, The Green Helmet and Other Poems (Cuala Press, 1910)
